# Telegram Commander

Telegram Commander is a free and open source Telegram bot for Linux servers. You
describe a menu of buttons in one YAML config file, and each button holds a shell
command. When an allowed Telegram account taps a button, the bot runs that command
on the machine and sends the output back to the chat. You can group buttons into
categories, ask for a confirmation before risky actions, limit who gets the menu,
and record every run in an audit log. Nothing listens for incoming connections:
the bot only connects out to Telegram, so no port is opened on the server. There
is no code to write and no web panel to secure.

## Documentation

- Home: https://telecommander.ir/
- Run in CLI (install and first run): https://telecommander.ir/user-guide/installation/download-and-run/
- Config file: https://telecommander.ir/user-guide/concepts/config-file/
- Menu: https://telecommander.ir/user-guide/concepts/menu/
- Functions: https://telecommander.ir/user-guide/functions/
- Configuration reference: https://telecommander.ir/user-guide/configuration/
- CLI reference: https://telecommander.ir/user-guide/cli/
